summary.tldr: Lets the Competition Commissioner recommend changes to trade barriers in inquiry reports and requires public responses from federal and provincial institutions.
what_it_does: Lets the Commissioner of Competition recommend changes to barriers to trade within Canada in market or industry inquiry reports, if the barrier unduly affects competition in that market or a related market.
Requires the Commissioner to send the report to the head of any federal or provincial institution named in a recommendation.
Requires federal institution heads to respond within 120 days, and requires the Commissioner to post the response on a publicly available website.
Lets provincial institution heads respond within 120 days, and requires the Commissioner to post the response or a notice that no response was received on a publicly available website.
summary.background: The bill adds new rules to section 10.1 of the Competition Act, which deals with market or industry inquiries.
